name: GambliX
detailed_description:
🃏 About This Game

GambliX is a low-poly online multiplayer casino game. You jump in, play classic gambling mini-games like blackjack, poker, roulette, and slots—against other real players.

The game’s designed to look simple and clean, with minimalistic 3D models and vibrant colors. It’s all about fast rounds, social chaos, and watching your chip stack rise or disappear in seconds. No real money involved—just in-game currency and a leaderboard to flex on.

This isn’t some deep story-driven experience. It’s just gambling with friends (or strangers), quick decision-making, and unpredictable outcomes in every session.

🎯 Key Features:

  • 🎲 Online Gambling Rooms: Blackjack, poker, roulette, and slot machines.

  • 👥 Multiplayer Focused: Everything is online, and everything’s competitive.

  • 🧊 Low-Poly Graphics: Simple, readable, and stylish visual design.

  • 🏁 Events: Occasional chip-based tournaments and challenges.

  • 💰 In-Game Currency: Win, lose, climb the ranks, and unlock game modes.
